deploy-bot: [DEPLOY BLOCKED] rc7 -> prod blocked by policy: SBOM signature missing for registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc7. Vuln scan: 1 LOW transitive CVE (CVE-2024-7777). Change window closes in ~90m. Ping @zoe @nina.

zoe (release): pinged. we need a quick decision: rollback, pin-canary, or exception. trade-offs?

nina (security): short: low-severity, no exploit. Compliance wants signed SBOM for GA but allows timeboxed canary with controls. Legal will need to sign off on exception.

leo: can we pin to the digest (if present) and run a 3% EU canary for 8h? I can set auto-rollback thresholds and alerting.

qa-team: we can run smoke + core-regression on canary in ~25m.

zoe (release): check image digest/signature please @leo.

leo: running inspect...
```
$ skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc7
Digest: sha256:c0ffee1234deadbeef567890abcdef12
Signatures: none
SBOM: present
```

leo: digest exists but unsigned. We can pin, but needs the exception controls.

nina (security): approve a timeboxed 12h pin for EU-only canary under these conditions: (1) 5% max traffic, (2) auto-rollback on errors>1% or p50 latency >25% over baseline for 5m, (3) signed SBOM must be attached within 12h or rollback triggers, (4) release notes must include approval and ticket REL-4999.

legal: ok with timeboxed 12h exception with audit trail and ticket logged.

zoe (release): decision: proceed with EU canary pinned to sha256:c0ffee1234deadbeef567890abcdef12 at 3% traffic, 12h expiry. QA to run smoke; Leo set rollback rules and alerting. I'll append exception note to release notes.

leo: command: ```bash
deploybot carveout --region eu-west-1 --image "registry.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:c0ffee1234deadbeef567890abcdef12" --traffic 3% --rollback-if "errors>1% or p50>25%" --expire 12h
```Executing in 15s. Monitoring -> #eng-oncall + #security.

deploy-bot: carving out canary to eu-west-1 using pinned digest sha256:c0ffee1234deadbeef567890abcdef12. Traffic: 3%. Auto-rollback rules set. Expiry: 12h.

qa-team: smoke started. first pass looks green, no 5xx spike. regression suite queued (ETA 20m).

leo: hooks in place, alerting configured.

zoe (release): note added to release notes: "EU canary pinned to sha256:c0ffee... due to missing SBOM signature. Timeboxed 12h. Security & Legal approved. Ticket REL-4999." Product wants status at +2h.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary-start ts=1717010200 status=running instances=4 health=4

(THREAD END)
